design: 2x2 evidence-presence diagnostic; four context cells, three independent fresh contexts per cell

factors.contract: The approved source contract explicitly requires a nonempty ordered list of nonempty strings.
factors.implementation_link: The exact method is linked through BDDScenarioValuesSpec and BDDPolicy to Specification evaluation and composition.

controlled_inputs: same exact target expression and original method-body context
same architecture profile, rubric bytes, questions, and annotation instructions
only contract and implementation-link evidence fragments vary
delivery: one cell per fresh annotator; no annotator sees another view of this target; three replicates per cell
primary_observations: opportunity and concern_kind label distributions per cell
decisive coverage per axis per cell
whether exact added fragments appear in rationales and evidence quotes

directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.contract: At fixed implementation-link presence, the adopted values contract may reduce uncertainty about whether empty steps are admissible. It does not predetermine policy versus mechanics: the source defines input shape and validity, not why the rule is a domain obligation or representation check.
directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.implementation_link: At fixed contract presence, a demonstrated same-decision Specification evaluation link may move opportunity toward excluded while leaving responsibility classification independently assessable.
directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.combined: The combined cell should provide enough evidence to assess whether the exact decision is already represented. The concern-kind axis may remain uncertain without evidence of domain purpose; this is a rubric-derived expectation, not an assigned answer.

interpretation_limits: One expression family; results are a context-sensitivity diagnostic, not classifier accuracy or population reliability.
Three fresh judgments per cell are descriptive and cannot establish statistical significance.
The source contract and code mapping live in the same canonical spec lineage; excerpt separation tests which evidence is useful to annotators, not independent real-world causes.
The approved values contract states that steps must be nonempty but does not itself resolve the rubric boundary between domain completeness and input representation mechanics.
Agent model identity is inherited and must be recorded as unverified unless the runtime exposes it.
Do not change v2 labels, failed H2, production prompts, S/U state, or metric storage from this diagnostic.
